label: Whatever has received esse is receiving it at a first moment of its presence
paraphrase: OPEN analyst premise, attribution deferred (onset reading of reception): in every history of the model, whatever has its esse received in a principle z (DEF-ESSE-RECEIVED-IN) is receiving its esse in z (Receipt.ReceivesAt, definition 506ea036) at a first moment of its presence (BeginsAt: present then and at no strictly earlier moment): 'x received esse at onset'. Silent on later moments and on things with no first moment of presence. It is the part of the past-tense reading that both sides grant: the past-tense reading proper is this premise together with denying receipt at later moments, which is not a statement here. Entailed by the present-tense reading (registered strength order). With correlativity it gives only that received onset is given (fa3e228b), which the inertialist grants.
